name: Prof Ada Cheung
title: Prof / Endocrinologist
practice: Prof Ada Cheung - Endocrinologist (private rooms, Heidelberg)
description: Specialist endocrinologist whose scope of practice includes Trans and Gender Diverse Health; leads trans health research at the University of Melbourne and sits on the AusPATH policy committee. GP referral required (doctor's referral letter must be uploaded with the appointment request). Private clinic with out-of-pocket fees (approx. $230 gap first visit); waitlist of several months and the waitlist is intermittently closed. She also works in Austin Health's bulk-billed Transgender Clinic. Consults Thursdays; telehealth available Australia-wide.
specialties: Trans and gender diverse health, gender-affirming hormone therapy, androgen deprivation therapy, thyroid, osteoporosis, pituitary, adrenal

name: Dr Ingrid Bretherton
title: Dr / Endocrinologist
description: Principal and founder of Inner North Endocrinology with a special interest in transgender health; her PhD investigated the effects of hormone therapy in gender diverse Australians. The clinic offers consultations to gender diverse adults (18+) to initiate or continue gender-affirming hormone therapy, using an informed consent model where suitable. GP or specialist referral required. Private billing (initial consult $410, ~$254 out of pocket); in-person and telehealth.
specialties: Transgender health, gender-affirming hormone therapy, bone health, general adult endocrinology

name: Dr Laura Donaldson
title: Dr / Endocrinologist
description: Endocrinologist who is 'particularly passionate about ... providing gender-affirming care'. Inner North Endocrinology offers gender-affirming hormone therapy initiation and continuation for adults (18+), using an informed consent model where suitable. GP or specialist referral required. Private billing; in-person and telehealth.
specialties: Gender-affirming care, diabetes, thyroid, obesity, pituitary
